svg.title: The Scene Exporter, from every caller
svg.desc: The Scene Exporter, from every caller: (1) In Maya, tentacle's Scene Exporter panel calls mayatk's exporter: its checks and fixes, then FBX, GLB or USD. (2) In Blender, the same panel calls blendertk's. Both share pythontk's host-free core: progress, consent, run config. (3) A script or a test makes the same call, with no panel at all. (4) An AI agent finds any public function: api_search reads every package's source and imports nothing. (5) Then it runs the export over MCP, in a Maya launched for it, never in a session a person has open.
